headline: Sanjay Gupta files SEBI Takeover Regulation 10(6) disclosure for acquisition in SG Mart Limited
sum: Sanjay Gupta has filed a regulatory disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 Regulation 10(6) regarding an acquisition in SG Mart Limited, relying on an exemption provided under Regulation 10 of the SAST Regulations.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE on 16 June 2026 by Sanjay Gupta in respect of an acquisition made under an exemption under Regulation 10 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. No acquisition value, shareholding percentage, or transaction date has been disclosed in the available public filings. The specific exemption category and the extent of the stake acquired remain unstated in the summary disclosure.
